messages:
marina: FYI — scheduled maintenance tonight 02:00–04:00 UTC for pool 'saturn' (apac-west1 + us-east1 shards). We'll do a rolling node reboot + kernel hotpatch. Expect ~15% available GPU capacity reduction in saturn during the window. Soft-drain cohorts of ~20 nodes every 10m, backfill from gradient-pool as needed. No full region failover planned.

ashok: oncall here — I'll kick off health checks 30m prior and watch tail latency. If any route > 250ms p95 or error rate spikes >5% we'll pause the rotation and escalate.

jamie: product — do we need to update the status page or customer comms for reserved/dedicated tenants?

marina: yes please. Lucy, can you flag dedicated customers with capacity reservations and add a brief note: 'maintenance may affect latency and transient request throttling for scheduled pools'?

lucy: on it. I'll pull the list and post to #support-alerts 45m before. I'll also ping the top 10 tenants. :loudspeaker:

sre-bot: [automation] scheduled_maintenance created by marina — window=2025-11-12T02:00:00Z/2025-11-12T04:00:00Z pools=[saturn] cohorts=20 interval_m=10

ashok: Runbook snippet for coordinators:
```bash
# precheck 30m before
./ops/check-pool-health --pool saturn --thresholds "p95_latency=200ms,error=2%"
# drain cohort
./ops/drain-cohort --pool saturn --count 20 --mode soft --wait 600
# backfill (if capacity < target)
./ops/backfill --from gradient-pool --to saturn --count 20
```

marina: rollback plan: if backfill fails or SLOs breach for >10m we stop further drains, cancel the next cohorts, and rehydrate with cached nodes + decrease workload weight via router-weights. We'll also kick an emergency canary rollback to the previous kernel if OOMs or driver panics observed.

sre-lead: cost note — anticipated backfill for worst-case could add ~3-6k USD for the window (spot burst + cross-region egress). Tagging "maintenance-2025-11-12" on all temporary instances so finance can track.

kyle: quick Q — any special network checks? last time we saw intermittent 5s TCP stalls during driver handshake in apac-west1.

ashok: good call. We'll run an egress stress test 1h prior and verify NIC temp and firmware counters. If we see retransmits >0.5% we'll hold.

marina: final checklist for tonight:
• preflight 60m: confirm cohort list, reserved tenants flagged, status page draft
• precheck 30m: health script run, egress test
• execution 02:00 UTC: soft-drain every 10m, monitor SLOs, backfill as needed
• rollback criteria: p95 >250ms for 10m, error rate >5% for 5m, kernel panic/ooms on backfill nodes
• post-window: sanity traffic sweep, KV cache warmup, cost tag & cleanup

lucy: I created the status page draft in #support-alerts and will schedule the tenant pings.

jamie: 👍 Product is aligned. We'll hold PRs that touch heavy batch jobs in the window.

ashok: I'll be primary oncall, marina backup. Paging policy updated in runbook. Ping me @ashok if you see anything weird.

marina: thanks everyone — plan to start preflight at 01:00 UTC. I'll post a short go/no-go 30m before. :wave:
